recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-15911; future edits to ele-1 should preserve the boolean `or` correction while separately considering later approved changes such as FHIR-26565.
issue_request: FHIR-15911 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ElementDefinition issue raised against STU3. It requested changing the ele-1 FHIRPath expression from collection union (`|`) to boolean `or`; Jira comments clarified that the `children().count() > id.count()` comparison was intentional because `id` is itself a child.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 13990, preserved in git as c50ea493463a70377e635b86153c803b73948953 (`GF#15911 - fix ele-1`), which changed source/datatypes/element.xml from `hasValue() | (children().count() > id.count())` to `hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())`.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists `Element=abstract`, making source/datatypes/element.xml the active source for the base Element invariant. The current source also includes a later empty Parameters exception from FHIR-26565, already represented on the combined branch by 6bf6d264f8b1d1ef33091c8e8752a9d7628a5ebc; that later clause explains why the current expression is broader than FHIR-15911's original resolution.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes/element.xml currently defines ele-1 with `hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count()) or $this is Parameters`, and a current-source search found no remaining copy of the original bad pipe expression.
